projects.title: Applications Opener
projects.description:
• Used Android phone sensors to open apps by shaking or rotating the phone.  
• Matching user location to open apps when on the selected locations. 
• The app runs in background & uses Google Maps API.

projects.title: New Jersey Drivers Knowledge Test App
projects.description:
I created an app using XML, Java, and SQLite. This app has 300+ real DMV questions to help people prepare for the knowledge test. 
- 20 questions are randomly selected from the 300+ questions. 
- The score, the number of questions, and time are displayed on top of the app.
- Simple UI to help understand the correct answer once an answer is selected. 
- Visit my GitHub for more info.
